title: Confidence Intervals Uncovered: Are We Ready for Real-World Medical Imaging AI?
mechanism: SD of Dice approximated by a quadratic in mean Dice, so CIs can be reconstructed for papers that report none.
adaptation: Reconstruct approximate CIs for published EL segmentation numbers in the benchmark's related-work table.
min_experiment: Arm: apply fit to published EL tables. Metric: share of claimed gains inside CI. Kill: reporting only.
evidence: R: 221 MICCAI 2023 papers; >50% report no variability; median CI width 0.03, three times the median first-second gap; >60% of runners-up inside the winner's CI.
